name: V.I.R.T.U.E.S. What-If scenario#1 -- Vera's Wild Wish
source:
The theme of this scenario is designed by one of our patrons.
This scenario happens in a parallel world that has nothing to do with the main story.
Theme: Single heroine, Vera, foursome, wife-sharing, love, no NTR.
Background: Vera and Huhn had become a lovely couple. Vera's lust had become extremely high.
